summary: Frontend-only verification of PRINT-cards-only change in PediDrip. Mobile viewport 430x900, weight=12. All acceptance criteria PASS: popup title 'PediDrip — Kartu Titrasi'; header contains 'Kartu titrasi syringe pump' and 'gunting garis putus-putus'; old therapy-table headers ('Lembar Terapi Infus Kontinu', 'Bolus / muat (sekali beri)', 'Total cairan dari infus kontinu') are ABSENT; both Midazolam and Epinefrin cards present (drug names visually uppercased via CSS text-transform, raw HTML contains 'Midazolam'/'Epinefrin'); columns 'Dosis' + 'mL/jam' + labels 'Nama pasien'/'No. RM' present; .cut count=2 (>= #checked drugs), .cm crop-marks count=8; Midazolam Bolus line shows '0,60 mL'; Epinefrin card contains 'henti jantung' and '1,67 mL'; Epinefrin Sediaan shows '3,6 mg' (weight-based). Empty-state: after reset (confirm), Cetak popup shows 'Isi berat badan dan centang minimal satu obat...'. Regression: read-midazolam='0,72'; theme-toggle click cycles without errors. No JS/console errors (only harmless RN-web pointerEvents deprecation warnings).
critical_code_review_comments: printHtml.js labelCard() correctly renders one .cut wrapper per selected drug with 4 .cm corner marks and the .tcard content; bolus line only appears when BOLUS[d.id] exists AND st.bolusDose > 0 — matches spec.

Drug names in card header appear uppercase via CSS 'text-transform:uppercase' on .tcard h4. Raw HTML retains original case ('Midazolam'). Any downstream automated test/regex should be case-insensitive.
print.js webPrint uses window.open then falls back to hidden iframe on popup block — good; setTimeout(500ms) before print() is reasonable for headless.
Old therapy-table header/labels fully removed from the print path; on-screen SummarySheet remains unaffected (not tested this round, but out of scope).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Print flow verified cards-only. Popup captured via context.expect_page(); popup title='PediDrip — Kartu Titrasi'. When asserting drug names in the popup HTML, do case-insensitive match ('Midazolam'/'Epinefrin') — CSS uppercases the display, not the source text. .cut elements = number of checked drugs; each has 4 .cm crop marks. Empty-state message: 'Isi berat badan dan centang minimal satu obat'.
